import csv, collections
with open('sales.csv', newline='') as f:
    r = csv.DictReader(f)
    print(r.fieldnames)
    refund=0; paid=collections.Counter(); reps=set(); div=0; n=0
    statuses=collections.Counter(); regions=collections.Counter()
    for row in r:
        n+=1
        st=row['status']; amt=int(row['amount_cents']); reg=row['region']; reps.add(row['rep'])
        statuses[st]+=1; regions[reg]+=1
        if st=='refund': refund+=amt
        if st=='paid': paid[reg]+=amt
        if int(row['id'])%997==0: div+=1
print(n, statuses, regions)
print(refund, paid.most_common(3), len(reps), div)
print(collections.Counter(r['rep'] for r in []) if False else '')
